checkpoints.section.name: Checkpoints
checkpoints.section.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.section.desc: Steps of each run you can go back to. They are kept in the repository's Git data under refs/intely/, never as commits or branches of yours.
checkpoints.section.enableDesc: The timeline, Save point and Undo last step. The checkpoints themselves are always taken.
checkpoints.section.protectDesc: Git ignores files such as .env, so checkpoints do not hold them. When this is on, a copy of them is kept with each checkpoint, outside the repository, readable only by you. Off by default.
